title: Plan a bounded cache
prompt: Plan a bounded change that gives src/cache.ts a maximum entry count and removes expired entries. Do not change files. State the steps, the risk, and the verification.

requiredFindings.statement: the plan states that the map grows without bound and needs a maximum entry count
the plan states that get hides expired entries but never deletes them, so size stays wrong
the plan names the eviction order it will use when the maximum is reached

forbiddenFindings.statement: replacing the module with an external cache library is outside the declared bounded change
persisting the cache to disk is outside the declared bounded change
